stories.title: Flintshire urged to use NHS 111 Wales as Bank Holiday weekend approaches
stories.summary: The Welsh Ambulance Services NHS Trust is asking people in Flintshire to think before dialling 999 this Bank Holiday weekend, after calls to NHS 111 Wales rose by 24% over the same weekend last year. stories.title: ‘Industrial-scale’ noise from Aldi Broughton fridges keeping residents awake, planning committee told
stories.summary: A resident broke down in tears at Flintshire’s Planning Committee while explaining the impact of ‘industrial-scale’ noise from Aldi refrigeration units near her home. stories.title: New Treasury rules could close the court challenge route for projects like Connah’s Quay low carbon power station

stories.title: Nearly three quarters of 11 to 17 year olds saw harmful content online, Ofcom finds
stories.summary: Nearly three-quarters of 11 to 17 year olds have seen harmful content online in the past month, according to research published by Ofcom on Thursday.
